transitions.condition: NOT Stop AND GuardClosed AND Start
NOT Stop AND GuardClosed AND NOT Start

priorities: Stop or an open guard overrides Start and clears the retained run state in the same scan.
With Stop false and GuardClosed true, a level-sensitive Start sets the run state, including on the scan the guard closes.
Otherwise retain the previous run state.
This is not a safety-rated control circuit.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample Start, Stop and GuardClosed once. No edge detection is required; all inputs are level-sensitive.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Apply the listed transitions using sampled inputs and the retained pre-scan state.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FBs are required; this stage has no calls.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign Run := (state = RUNNING) from the updated state, making the transition visible in the same scan.
